notes: The two heads («ابن نمير» and «زهير ... الحلواني قالا») each repeat Ya'qub and his father, so they are two groups; the names written once after the last repetition form the shared tail (rule 3).
«- وهو ابن إبراهيم -» is an identifying gloss: left out. «أبي» is Ya'qub's father, named only by relation.
Abu Bakr is quoted as the one who heard the Prophet («فقال لها أبو بكر إن رسول الله قال»): a link after Aisha (rule 6). The Fatima story is scene.
